description: This file defines the 'Loader' class within the Opencart System Engine namespace. The class provides methods for loading models, libraries, configurations, helpers, and managing other system components with integrated event triggers, caching via the registry, and dynamic method handling.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: Provides methods to load models, libraries, configs, helpers, and controllers dynamically. Integrates with event management and caches loaded components in the registry.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the loader with a registry object.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to access properties from the registry.

methods.name: controller
methods.description: Loads and executes a controller action based on a route and arguments, managing pre- and post-execution events.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Loads a model class, instantiates it, stores it in the registry, and provides callable access.

methods.name: library
methods.description: Loads a library, initializes, and caches it in the registry for reuse.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Loads configuration data for a specific route and manages associated events.

methods.name: helper
methods.description: Includes helper PHP files, handling default and extension-specific helpers with error handling if not found.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Renders a view template with supplied data, managing pre- and post-render events.

methods.name: language
methods.description: Loads language files for proper localization, with event triggers before and after.
